_doc: Rules of the trainer prototype (feel numbers live here, not in code). trainer: the person you play; never damaged. aura: your creature deals more damage near you. commands: the trainer's own buttons (A S D G), stronger with bond (command_bond_scale at full bond). perfect_swap: swapping just as a wild attack is about to land on your creature. white_out: every creature knocked out -> back to camp (lose `lose` of each material). items: keys 4 and 5. control: your creature in battle (camera blend, speed, dodge, outline). partner: how your creature follows and picks fights. wild: behaviour and scaling (windup: the telegraphed pause before every wild attack). befriend: F sends the trainer to calm a dazed wild creature. bond: meter 0-100 per creature. camp: the rest point. materials and upgrades: the grind loop. spawn: wild packs (size grows deeper in). guide: the tracker's steps in order.

meet.caption: Three young creatures are waiting in the meadow. Walk up to each, then click the one you want.

guide.text: Meet the three creatures and click one to choose it
Right-click a wild creature to start a battle. Then YOU are your creature: left click moves, right click attacks, hold Q W E R to aim a move
Win a battle: Space dodges the red warnings, hover the move icons to learn your moves
Help as the trainer: A Cheer, S Focus, D Rally, G Mark. Your creature hits harder inside your ring
Weaken a wild creature until it is dazed, then press F: your trainer calms it
Press 1, 2 or 3 to swap. Swap just before a red warning lands for a perfect swap
Rest at the camp (the fire, up the path): heal, pet and feed
At camp, spend materials to raise a stat
Battle together to fill the bond meter and unlock a bond move (T)
Explore: find the shiny maned wolf, raise your team at camp, unlock every bond move

cheer.name: Cheer
cheer.desc: Your creature hits 30% harder for 6 s.

focus.name: Focus
focus.desc: Its next move is a critical hit (x1.8).

rally.name: Rally
rally.desc: Heals your creature 30% of its life over 5 s.

mark.name: Mark
mark.desc: Mark the wild creature under the cursor: your creature goes for it and deals 25% more to it.

white_out.text: Your team is worn out. You hurry back to camp, and they recover by the fire.
